programs.name: cv_periodic_replay
programs.description: Use when a short sampling interval hides a longer repeating cycle and persistence is safer than extrapolating cycle-to-cycle level changes.
programs.assumption: Among lags from 12 to min(180, floor(n/2)), the selected lag reduces median absolute rolling error by at least 8% versus a 12-point median-level forecast.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when no candidate lag achieves the 8% error reduction or when the last two inferred cycles differ in median absolute level by more than three times their within-cycle first-difference scale.

programs.name: nearest_motif_continuation
programs.description: Use when the recent trajectory has appeared earlier but the series level may have shifted, making shape matching more reliable than fixed seasonal phase.
programs.assumption: A past 18-to-36-point window has a centered shape distance at least 15% smaller than the median candidate distance, and its following segment has lower hindcast error than recent-level persistence.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when no separated historical motif clears the 15% distance margin, or when matched continuations disagree by more than twice the recent first-difference scale.

programs.name: rolling_cv_ensemble
programs.description: Use when fold performance is unstable and the forecast should switch numerically among recent-level, damped-trend, and periodic models.
programs.assumption: Rolling-origin errors over the last min(90, floor(n/2)) observations rank at least one candidate consistently enough that inverse-error weighting lowers mean absolute error by 5% versus the recent-level candidate alone.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when all candidate rolling errors are within 5%, when the chosen period changes by more than 20% across adjacent validation halves, or when a new level break occurs after the final observation.
